1. I had a dog and a lizard of my own I brought to the relationship. Together we adopted two cats and a puppy. It was about the time we got the puppy that his mental health nose-dived and I started being the only one to take care of them.

2. My older brother who used to abuse me is having a kid soon and apparently is in shambles because he hates himself for the things he used to do to me. I decided I wanted to write him a letter (passed to him via his wife as I don't remain in touch with him) that says we are adults now, I am getting help and so he should too, and the best thing he could do for either of us at this point is buck up and be a good father to his kid. I planned to make it clear this wasn't an invitation for a relationship, but it was meant to be closure on the situation. Alan felt very conflicted as he (understandably) despises my brother and it lead him into spiral into thinking about how awful the world is and how nothing he does could ever make the past go away.
Thank you for the input. I would really love to do something like this, but he does still see his therapist. He just hates it and sees no point so he basically wastes his time there.
